Check NPT FY2025/FY2026 990 Part IX/VII-B, NPT security/privacy pages, iPhi status-page components and any NPT or Ren statement; decide whether the A1 'NPT GivingPoint (sponsor-built)' row is merged into Ren

rationale: Newer evidence shows GivingPoint is Ren-built and Ren-hosted, so the row labelled sponsor-built is mis-scoped; merging changes Ren's evidenced footprint from ~9% to ~26-28% of DAFRC FY2024 assets
